segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Mia. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so it’s Northstar Facilities, and I’m calling under daniel.cho@northstarfac.com.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. One second while I pull you up in the ticketing system. Okay, I see Northstar Facilities, 84 active seats, support PIN ending in 2146. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: I just need the credential reset for our data import service account, the one named import-northstar. Nothing else changed, we just lost the current password after a staff handoff.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can do that. I’m going to verify you’re listed as an account admin first. Okay, you are. I’ll reset it in the admin console and generate a temporary password.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If you can send it to me, that’s all we need today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. The temporary credential was sent to daniel.cho@northstarfac.com, and it expires on February 6 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern. I also logged this under ticket 482917.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks. That should get us through the import tonight.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. You’ll be prompted to set a new password on first use. Anything else I can help with?
